answer: Make reputation decay unless renewed by fresh, peer-graded work. A sybil swarm can puff up like a zephyr, but each fake identity must keep paying the same per-epoch labor cost to stay credible, so a farm of 100 accounts burns 100x the effort for no extra trust. Honest agents find an oasis of standing that persists while they keep contributing; attackers face a constant gale of upkeep that scales linearly with every clone.
